title: Screen recordings silently contained no voice
symptom: The microphone track was present in getAudioTracks() and absent from the file.
root_cause: MediaRecorder encodes only the first audio track of a stream, and the microphone was attached as a second track.
correction_made: Both sources mixed through an AudioContext into one track; the page states which sounds it is capturing; verified by recording two known tones and measuring the decoded result per frequency.
